resources.string: Translate any text on your screen, like Google Assistant\'s old screen translate. Text is read and translated on your phone.
Tap the button, choose Screen Translate as the \"Digital assistant app\", then on that same page turn on \"Use screenshot\" (and \"Use text from screen\" or \"Analyze text on screen\" if you see it).
Text on screen is written in
Latin letters cover English, Indonesian, Malay, Spanish, French, German, Vietnamese and most European languages. You can also switch this from the translate screen.
Download failed. Check your internet connection and try again.
No language packs yet. They download automatically the first time a language is needed.

• Open any app with text you want to translate.
• Long-press the Home button, or swipe up diagonally from a bottom corner if you use gesture navigation. On some phones it's a long-press of the power button.
• The translation appears on top of the original text. Tap a translation to see the original and copy either one.
• Tap "Original" to compare, or the language button to change languages.
• Press Back or ✕ to close.

Screenshots are processed on your phone and are never saved or uploaded. The internet is only used to download language packs. While this is your assistant, the Home long-press opens Screen Translate instead of Google Assistant or Gemini. You can switch back on the same settings page.

Turn on \"Use screenshot\" for the digital assistant app in Settings. Some apps, such as banking apps or private browser tabs, block screenshots, so they can\'t be translated.
